title: Binance Chat: Creator Beta Now Open!
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To help creators build stronger communities and better serve their core followers, Binance Chat is now opening a Creator Beta. Selected creators will be invited to experience the feature first-hand and create their own dedicated fan group chats within Binance! What is Binance Chat: Creators can build a dedicated community for deeper, higher-quality discussions with their followers with Binance Chat: Grow your reach — your chatroom appears on your Binance Square profile so followers can join instantly.  Share market views and trade ideas — followers can trade directly on Binance, and you can earn up to 50% referral commissions. Boost participation with Red Packets — run simple giveaways to keep the group active. Eligibility Access to the Creator Beta is being rolled out in batches to eligible Binance users. At this stage, it’s available to creators with more than 1,000 Binance Square followers. You can check your eligibility by checking whether the “Create Group Chat” button is available on your Binance App. How to Use Binance Chat: Tap the Chat icon in the top-left corner of the Binance App homepage. Select [Chat] to enter your chat list. Tap the [+] icon in the top-right corner to start a new chat. For more information, please refer to this  FAQ guide . Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
